title: Confluence whiteboards: Group elements to organize your work
description:
Organize your Confluence whiteboards by grouping multiple elements together. This change allows you to move, resize, and duplicate collections of items as a single unit, helping you maintain the structure of your ideas as they evolve. To group and ungroup multiple elements on a whiteboard: Open a whiteboard in Confluence.
	Select multiple elements by dragging a selection box around them or by holding the Shift key on your keyboard when selecting multiple elements.
